title: Psalm 144
opening_line: O blessèd ever be the LORD,

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: O blessèd ever be the LORD,
text.normalized: O blessèd ever be the LORD,

text.diplomatic: who is my strength and might,
text.normalized: Who is my strength and might,
text.reading: who is my strength and might,

text.diplomatic: Who doth instruct my hands to war,
text.normalized: Who doth instruct my hands to war,
text.reading: Who doth instruct my hands to war,

text.diplomatic: my fingers teach to fight.
text.normalized: My fingers teach to fight.
text.reading: my fingers teach to fight.

text.diplomatic: My goodness, fortress, my high tower,
text.normalized: My goodness, fortress, my high tower,
text.reading: My goodness, fortress, my high tower,

text.diplomatic: deliverer, and shield,
text.normalized: Deliverer, and shield,
text.reading: deliverer, and shield,

text.diplomatic: In whom I trust: who under me
text.normalized: In whom I trust: who under me
text.reading: In whom I trust: who under me

text.diplomatic: my people makes to yield.
text.normalized: My people makes to yield.
text.reading: my people makes to yield.

text.diplomatic: LORD, what is man, that thou of him
text.normalized: LORD, what is man, that thou of him

text.diplomatic: dost so much knowledge take?

text.reading: dost so much knowledge take?

text.diplomatic: Or son of man, that thou of him
text.normalized: Or son of man, that thou of him

text.diplomatic: so great account dost make?
text.normalized: So great account dost make?
text.reading: so great account dost make?

text.diplomatic: Man is like vanity; his days,

text.reading: Man is like vanity; his days,

text.diplomatic: as shadows, pass away.
text.normalized: As shadows, pass away.
text.reading: as shadows, pass away.

text.diplomatic: LORD, bow thy heav’ns, come down, touch thou
text.normalized: LORD, bow thy heav’ns, come down, touch thou
text.reading: LORD, bow thy heav’ns, come down, touch thou

text.diplomatic: the hills, and smoke shall they.
text.normalized: The hills, and smoke shall they.
text.reading: the hills, and smoke shall they.

text.diplomatic: Cast forth thy lightning, scatter them;
text.normalized: Cast forth thy lightning, scatter them;
text.reading: Cast forth thy lightning, scatter them;

text.diplomatic: thine arrows shoot, them rout.
text.normalized: Thine arrows shoot, them rout.
text.reading: thine arrows shoot, them rout.

text.diplomatic: Thine hand send from above, me save;
text.normalized: Thine hand send from above, me save;
text.reading: Thine hand send from above, me save;

text.diplomatic: from great depths draw me out;
text.normalized: From great depths draw me out;
text.reading: from great depths draw me out;

text.diplomatic: And from the hand of children strange,
text.normalized: And from the hand of children strange,
text.reading: And from the hand of children strange,

text.diplomatic: Whose mouth speaks vanity;
text.normalized: Whose mouth speaks vanity;
text.reading: Whose mouth speaks vanity;

text.diplomatic: And their right hand is a right hand
text.normalized: And their right hand is a right hand
text.reading: And their right hand is a right hand

text.diplomatic: that works deceitfully.
text.normalized: That works deceitfully.
text.reading: that works deceitfully.

text.diplomatic: A new song I to thee will sing,
text.normalized: A new song I to thee will sing,
text.reading: A new song I to thee will sing,

text.diplomatic: Lord, on a psaltery;
text.normalized: Lord, on a psaltery;
text.reading: Lord, on a psaltery;

text.diplomatic: I on a ten-stringed instrument
text.normalized: I on a ten-stringed instrument

text.diplomatic: will praises sing to thee.
text.normalized: Will praises sing to thee.
text.reading: will praises sing to thee.

text.diplomatic: Ev’n he it is that unto kings

text.diplomatic: salvätion doth send;

text.diplomatic: from hurtful sword defend.
text.normalized: From hurtful sword defend.
text.reading: from hurtful sword defend.

text.diplomatic: O free me from strange children’s hand,
text.normalized: O free me from strange children’s hand,
text.reading: O free me from strange children’s hand,

text.diplomatic: whose mouth speaks vanity;
text.normalized: Whose mouth speaks vanity;
text.reading: whose mouth speaks vanity;

text.diplomatic: And their right hand a right hand is
text.normalized: And their right hand a right hand is
text.reading: And their right hand a right hand is

text.diplomatic: that works deceitfully.
text.normalized: That works deceitfully.
text.reading: that works deceitfully.

text.diplomatic: That, as the plants, our sons may be

text.normalized: In youth grown up that are;
text.reading: in youth grown up that are;

text.diplomatic: Our daughters like to corner-stones,
text.normalized: Our daughters like to corner-stones,
text.reading: Our daughters like to corner-stones,

text.diplomatic: carved like a palace fair.
text.normalized: Carved like a palace fair.
text.reading: carved like a palace fair.

text.diplomatic: That to afford all kind of store
text.normalized: That to afford all kind of store
text.reading: That to afford all kind of store

text.diplomatic: our garners may be filled;
text.normalized: Our garners may be filled;
text.reading: our garners may be filled;

text.diplomatic: That our sheep thousands, in our streets
text.normalized: That our sheep thousands, in our streets

text.normalized: Ten thousands they may yield.
text.reading: ten thousands they may yield.

text.diplomatic: That strong our oxen be for work,
text.normalized: That strong our oxen be for work,
text.reading: That strong our oxen be for work,

text.diplomatic: that no in-breaking be,
text.normalized: That no in-breaking be,
text.reading: that no in-breaking be,

text.diplomatic: Nor going out; and that our streets
text.normalized: Nor going out; and that our streets
text.reading: Nor going out; and that our streets

text.diplomatic: may from complaints be free.
text.normalized: May from complaints be free.
text.reading: may from complaints be free.

text.diplomatic: Those people blessèd are who be
text.normalized: Those people blessèd are who be
text.reading: Those people blessèd are who be

text.diplomatic: in such a case as this;
text.normalized: In such a case as this;
text.reading: in such a case as this;

text.diplomatic: Yea, blessèd all those people are,
text.normalized: Yea, blessèd all those people are,

text.diplomatic: whose God JEHOVAH is.
